name: Oxnard

routes.outcome: Official City of Oxnard ArcGIS parcel Feature Layer metadata loaded; polygon geometry, APN, OBJECTID, source CRS WKID 102645, and GeoJSON support were observed.

Layer configuration/schema loaded. Geometry is esriGeometryPolygon; native fields inspected were OBJECTID, APN, APN_SUFFIX, SITE_USE, ACREAGE, and SITUS. Only OBJECTID/APN were requested from the query; unsafe fields were not requested or retained.

Bounded anonymous envelope query around the exact preserved WUP point returned 125 GeoJSON polygon features with outFields=OBJECTID,APN and outSR=4326. Three full polygons with APN-only properties were retained in oxnard-sample.geojson.
City first-party page links GIS and spatial data, supporting local City GIS custodianship; it is not itself a parcel-vector response.
County first-party parcel layer was identified as a corroborating route. No county sample was retained because the City-hosted layer already provided the bounded safe response.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: ArcGIS REST layer metadata directly exposed the service schema; no browser login or private token was needed.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Source WKID 102645 / latest WKID 2229; retained sample requested and returned in EPSG:4326 coordinate order [longitude, latitude].
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: APN (source field); OBJECTID is a source OID and was not used in retained properties.
schemaAndCrs.boundedAnonymousResponse: 125 features in the specified envelope; not a citywide extract.

localCustodianAssessment: City of Oxnard GIS Division is the local municipal GIS custodian evidenced by the City-hosted service copyright and City GIS pages. Ventura County GIS is a corroborating county service. General national material was not used as local registry evidence.

qualification.reason: A real public parcel geometry service is evidenced, but independent serial review is required before adapter/runtime consideration.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
The bounded query is not evidence of citywide completeness or legal title status.
Only three full polygons are retained; each has exactly one canonical native identity in properties.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
This packet records research completion only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The public first-party City parcel layer and safe APN-plus-geometry response are verified for a bounded Oxnard envelope. Citywide coverage, update cadence, APN identity stability, licensing, and legal cadastral authority remain unverified.
